verdict.rationale: Skills and plugins are plain files/directories (SKILL.md, plugin.json with a version field) distributed via git-based marketplaces that provide 'version tracking, automatic updates' (anthropic-skills-docs-8, -27, -36), so version control and rollback are achievable via git, and skill-creator supports iterative improvement (anthropic-skills-docs-13/14/30). However, there is no documented review/approval workflow, changelog, diffing, or explicit rollback command dedicated to automations. Missing for 10: a first-party review/approval mechanism, an explicit rollback UI/command, and audit-trail evidence beyond generic marketplace version tracking.
